mapper.select: SELECT n.notification_id AS notificationId, n.event_type AS eventType, n.source_type AS sourceType, n.source_id AS sourceId, c.owner_id AS targetId, n.title, n.summary, n.created_at AS createdAt, n.read_at AS readAt FROM public.tb_notification n LEFT JOIN public.tb_common_comment c ON n.source_type = 'APPROVAL_COMMENT' AND c.tenant_id = n.tenant_id AND c.comment_id = n.source_id AND c.owner_type = 'APPROVAL' WHERE n.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND n.recipient_user_id = #{userId} AND n.notification_id = #{notificationId} AND n.archived_at IS NULL
